model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" of various multilingual language models—XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across different language families, including Indo-European subgroups (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other), as well as Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic languages. The horizontal axis categorizes the language families, while the vertical axis represents the effect, scaled from 0 to 30 with linear increments of 10. Each language family has a grouped set of five bars, each corresponding to one of the five models, color-coded as per the legend: light blue for XLM-L₂, dark blue for mBERT-R₂, light green for XLM-R₂, dark green for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The effect values vary significantly across models and language families. For instance, in the IE-Indic group, the mBERT-R₂ (light green) and XLM-R₂ (dark green) models show the highest effects, reaching approximately 20–22, while XLM-L₂ (light blue) and mBERT-B₂ (pink) are lower, around 2–3. In contrast, for the Semitic family, XLM-L₂ (light blue) and XLM-B₂ (red) show higher effects (around 15–20), while mBERT-R₂ (dark blue) and mBERT-B₂ (pink) are lower, with mBERT-R₂ even showing a negative effect. The Uralic family generally exhibits very low or near-zero effects across all models. The bars are arranged in groups by language family, with no apparent sorting order among families, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond the error bars.
